notes.title: Blunted in The Malen delayed to the first quarter of 2025
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello, dear Malen residents.[/h2][/b]
We regret to inform you that we are rescheduling [b]Blunted in The Malen[/b] to the first [u]quarter of 2025[/u] for a smoother and higher quality experience.
During this period we will participate in the Next Fest in [u]October[/u] with another demo. 

The delay also makes it impossible to say anything definite about the languages we will add. If we have enough time and money, we will translate the previously promised languages. 

[u]Thank you for your valuable time and patience.[/u]

notes.title: v0.2.4.1 (hotfix)
notes.content:
[h3]Changed:[/h3]

- Highlight feature now only shows quest related objects.
- Highlight feature no longer shows objects when not useful.

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]

- Small gap in home floor fixed.

notes.title: v0.2.4
notes.content:
[h3]New:[/h3]

- Added alternative exit method for diary and drawer screen.
- Added alt and mmb key alternatively for Highlight.
- Added Tab key as an alternative to exit the current screen.
- Unclickable doors can now be clicked.
- Added wishlist button for main menu.

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]

- Reworked the drawer on the upper floor.
- The function of the Highlight button has been redesigned.
- Dialog toggle button now activates as selected.
- English localization bug fix.
- The blurred background of the diary screen no longer leaves part of the screen blank.
- Diary can no longer be opened more than once.
- Character no longer moves on the diary screen.
- Fixed a bug where a few sounds were not getting lowered with the settings.
- Fixed the alignment of graphics settings.

notes.title: v0.2.3.7
notes.content:
v0.2.3.7:

[h3]New:[/h3]

- Added a hint button that shows the intractable objects in the game.
- 3D diary replaced with 2D pixel art version.

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]

- The size of the game has been significantly reduced.
- Removed the need to install the game's own libraries.
- Cursor no longer exits the game for multi-monitor users.
- Typewriter effect disable option.
- Bug report screen for game crashes.

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese language support!
notes.content:
We added a surprise language support that was not among the languages we said we would translate.

Special thanks to translator Thiago Mania for reaching out to us and doing high quality work in a short time.

Also, the Russian and Chinese translations are almost finished and we will share them soon.

We may have to cancel the Japanese and French translations, for which we apologize to our Japanese and French followers.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]

 v0.2.3.4:

[h3]New:[/h3]

- Dust effect added to the basement scene.

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]

- Credits updated.
- Fixed a bug where the game would open with a white screen (slide the graphics preset slider if you are still experiencing this bug)

notes.title: v0.2.3.2
notes.content:
v0.2.3.2:

[h3]New:[/h3]

- Added new forest scene sound.
- Pause menu setting panel added.

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]

- Fixed a bug that prevented names from overflowing from nameplates.
- Graphics presets have been revised.
- Changed the table in the kitchen as it was causing shadow problems.
- Fixed a bug that caused solving the radio quest without turning on the radio.
- The correct frequency is no longer triggered when the radio is on but muted.
- Changed the location of the portraits in the final scene.
- Localization fixes.

notes.title: 0.2.3.1.2 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h3]Bugfix:[/h3]

- A bug that caused not being able to talk to Gwen has been fixed.
- A bug that caused portraits to appear blurry in the final scene was fixed.
- Updated dialog panel for non-1920x1080 resolutions.

notes.title: We relased our demo!
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction:[/h1]

Hello there! We've just released a demo of Blunted in the Malen. We're very excited to be releasing an open demo for the first time on Steam. 

We've tested our demo a lot and we've done our best to make sure you don't encounter any bugs. However, if you do encounter any, we ask you to be patient and let us know. We will try to resolve it as soon as possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984010/Blunted_in_The_Malen_Demo/


[h1]Language options:[/h1]

Currently: 
[list]
[*] English 
[*] Turkish 
[/list] is available as language options.

We will start translations:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] French
[*] Japanese
[*] Russian
[*] Georgian
[/list]
Unfortunately, we couldn't catch up with the translated languages and we plan to add these languages a few days after the demo is released. Also, we cannot promise that all these languages will be included.

You can also contact us at any time on [url=https://discord.com/invite/SFjZgAnrKX]Discord [/url]or in-game feedback tab.
